notes: Copies the project's %wt_or(dx, var) macro from Analysis.sas's Univariate OR section verbatim (PROC SURVEYLOGISTIC with the project's own WEIGHT/CLUSTER/STRATA/domain survey-design statements and CLASS ref= coding), redirecting the hardcoded ODS RTF output path to a relative one. Mock data mirrors the project's own dataset/outcome-variable naming: the macro's outcome column is trt_&dx., and the project calls %wt_or(COMBINED, sex) with the dataset literally named COMBINED, so the mock cohort's outcome column is named trt_COMBINED to match what the macro actually binds to (that naming quirk is the source repo's own, not introduced here).
